defects.finding: Opening-cohort costing and inspection replacement precede the later basic FIFO/weighted-average and component-replacement teaching; revalued impairment likewise precedes the basic revaluation subsection beginning on144. The individual examples state their inputs, but the chapter reintroduces foundations after richer applications without explaining that return or distinguishing the teaching roles. This is an argument-order defect, not evidence that the local arithmetic is wrong.
defects.repair_trigger: After complete diagnosis, stage the ordinary cost/component/revaluation foundations before their richer extensions, or integrate exact earlier explanations and explicit transitions that justify a reference-only return.
